runtime_scenarios.setup: Two authenticated clients belong to the same OS principal and project; source owns epoch 1 and has an active run and queued follow-up.
expected: Host returns ACKNOWLEDGED while pausing; no target write is admitted yet.
After tools settle and checkpoint is durable, one CAS moves owner to target, increases epoch/revision, and emits CLIENT_HANDOFF.
Goal/Task identity and queued follow-up are preserved; no CANCELLED transition and no automatic task resumption.

runtime_scenarios.setup: Requester may read the project but has a different authenticated OS principal from the current writer.
expected: Host returns WRITER_BUSY after ordinary project/role authorization; no pause, lease transfer, tool effect or privilege grant.
Clients lacking ordinary project/role authorization are rejected as FORBIDDEN before ownership data is disclosed.

runtime_scenarios.setup: Request was formed from revision 1; the current session has revision 2 or an expired/revoked authenticated connection.
expected: Stale session snapshot returns VERSION_CONFLICT and current revision; no automatic retry with a fresh revision.
An expired/revoked connection must reauthenticate before any request; it does not gain authority by providing a prior epoch.

runtime_scenarios.setup: Two destination clients send distinct explicit takeover commands against the same observed revision.
expected: Exactly one transfer is reserved and committed; the other returns WRITER_BUSY or VERSION_CONFLICT.
At no time are there two valid writers or duplicate worker dispatches.

runtime_scenarios.setup: Source has an active tool that does not reach a safe settled point within the bounded wait.
expected: No transfer commits; pending receipt/diagnostic remains visible and existing effects are reconciled.
Requester remains read-only; no second worker is started and no implicit cancel is issued.

runtime_scenarios.setup: User explicitly cancels the original run while takeover is waiting for a safe pause.
expected: Explicit cancellation retains its original authority and precedence.
Takeover never revives the cancelled run or clears resume_requires_explicit_user; any committed transfer only changes control ownership.

runtime_scenarios.setup: New session has no selected editable Task.
expected: Save is disabled and links to existing Goal/Task selection; client does not send workspace.write with an invented task id.
Selecting a valid authorized existing Task enables save; no automatic DRAFT Goal/Task or model run is created.
